key_points: Neither headline constitutes a hard catalyst (no earnings surprise, guidance change, regulatory event, M&A, or major management/news milestone).
Seeking Alpha piece reinforces a constructive thesis (growth mode, stable EBITDA expansion, ~6% yield) but is contributor opinion, not new fundamental information.
Zacks article is generic attention-seeking commentary with no substantive new data — effectively noise.
For a mature midstream name like Enbridge, these headlines align with the existing income-investor narrative rather than shifting the thesis in either direction.
No actionable re-rating trigger present; investor should maintain existing view and monitor for actual catalyst events.
